forum.title: How to use STM32 U3 DMA for ADC conversion but using software trigger
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@rajasjoshi and welcome to the community,

I recommend you to refer to [ADC\_MultiChannelSingleConversion\_Init](https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/STM32CubeU3/tree/main/Projects/NUCLEO-U385RG-Q/Examples_LL/ADC/ADC_MultiChannelSingleConversion_Init) example and get inspired to check your code.

This example explains how to use an ADC peripheral to convert several channels. ADC conversions are performed successively in a scan sequence. This example is based on the STM32U3xx ADC LL API.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/b33a295b-43e3-4081-9759-439aa62399e4.png)

I hope this help you.

Thank you.

Kaouthar
